entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Returns' or 'Technical Support' to be routed to the correct department.
Returns.
Connecting you to a Returns Specialist now.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, you're speaking with Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hi, I need to return a VeloBand Pulse. Just send me the return label.
I can certainly look into that for you. To pull up your account, could I please get your order number?
VF-987654321. Just need the label, I don't have time for a long call.

Understood. One moment... Okay, I see the order for the VeloBand Pulse, delivered on January 8th. I do need to ask, to make sure I handle this correctly for you, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
It's neither. Look, I was told I could return it. Can you process this or not?

I understand your frustration, and I want to help. The policy for the VeloBand Pulse is a strict 10-day return window due to hygiene protocols. Since your item was delivered 15 days ago, we are outside of that standard window.

Ten days? Are you serious? I couldn't return it because I had a family emergency. My husband was rushed to the hospital and needed unexpected surgery. The last thing on my mind was returning a fitness band.
Oh, I am very sorry to hear that. Please disregard what I just said about the policy. VeloFit absolutely makes exceptions for situations like that. I hope everything is okay now.
It's getting better, thank you. So, can you process the return?

Yes, absolutely. Thank you for sharing that. I am noting a one-time medical exception on your account right now. Given the emergency, I'm authorized to approve a full refund. This situation is exactly what our exception policy is for.
Oh. Okay, great. I really appreciate you doing that. Thank you.

It's my pleasure. It's the least we can do. I've just processed the authorization, and you will receive an email with a pre-paid shipping label within the next five minutes. Once we receive the item, your full refund will be issued back to your original payment method.
Perfect. That's all I needed. Thanks, Charlie.
You are very welcome. I wish your husband a swift and complete recovery. Is there anything else I can assist with today?
No, that's it.
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good rest of your day.
